english.Prov.1.1: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
english.Prov.1.2: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
english.Prov.1.3: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
english.Prov.1.4: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man:
english.Prov.1.5: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
english.Prov.1.6: to understand a proverb, and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
english.Prov.1.7: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
english.Prov.1.8: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
english.Prov.1.9: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
english.Prov.1.10: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
english.Prov.1.11: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lay in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
english.Prov.1.12: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
english.Prov.1.13: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
english.Prov.1.14: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse.”
english.Prov.1.15: My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
english.Prov.1.16: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
english.Prov.1.17: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;
english.Prov.1.18: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
english.Prov.1.19: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
english.Prov.1.20: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
english.Prov.1.21: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
english.Prov.1.22: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
english.Prov.1.23: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
english.Prov.1.24: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
english.Prov.1.25: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
english.Prov.1.26: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,
english.Prov.1.27: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.
english.Prov.1.28: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;
english.Prov.1.29: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.
english.Prov.1.30: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
english.Prov.1.31: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
english.Prov.1.32: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
english.Prov.1.33: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
english.Prov.2.1: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
english.Prov.2.2: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
english.Prov.2.3: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
english.Prov.2.4: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures:
english.Prov.2.5: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
english.Prov.2.6: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
english.Prov.2.7: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
english.Prov.2.8: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
english.Prov.2.9: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
english.Prov.2.10: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
english.Prov.2.11: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
english.Prov.2.12: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
english.Prov.2.13: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
english.Prov.2.14: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,
english.Prov.2.15: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,
english.Prov.2.16: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
english.Prov.2.17: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;
english.Prov.2.18: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
english.Prov.2.19: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
english.Prov.2.20: So you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
english.Prov.2.21: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
english.Prov.2.22: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
english.Prov.3.1: My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
english.Prov.3.2: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
english.Prov.3.3: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
english.Prov.3.4: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
english.Prov.3.5: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
english.Prov.3.6: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
english.Prov.3.7: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
english.Prov.3.8: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
english.Prov.3.9: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:
english.Prov.3.10: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
english.Prov.3.11: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
english.Prov.3.12: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
english.Prov.3.13: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
english.Prov.3.14: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
english.Prov.3.15: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
english.Prov.3.16: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
english.Prov.3.17: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
english.Prov.3.18: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
english.Prov.3.19: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
english.Prov.3.20: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
english.Prov.3.21: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
english.Prov.3.22: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
english.Prov.3.23: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
english.Prov.3.24: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
english.Prov.3.25: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
english.Prov.3.26: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
english.Prov.3.27: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
english.Prov.3.28: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
english.Prov.3.29: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
english.Prov.3.30: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
english.Prov.3.31: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
english.Prov.3.32: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
english.Prov.3.33: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
english.Prov.3.34: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
english.Prov.3.35: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
